summary: Frontend-only test of the NEW sidebar İŞ KOLU filter TREE in TasksPanel. All 7 primary acceptance criteria pass: (1) vertical tree with TÜMÜ at top and KOLSUZ at bottom, (2) default-collapsed children under Fason Verme, (3) expand/collapse via category-node-toggle-Fason Verme chevron works, (4) localStorage 'sertex_catfilter_expanded_v1' keyed by user id persists both expanded and collapsed states across reload, (5) filter buttons category-chip-QA_AltA / category-chip-Fason Verme / category-chip-all / category-chip-none all respond (chip counts confirm), (6) rollup counts Fason Verme (2/5) include children (QA_AltA 1/1 + QA_AltB 0/1 + 3 other tasks), plus progress bars & detach buttons per node, (7) sibling-only drag guard code-verified in TasksPanel.handleCatDrop (parent_id equality check + toast.info 'Sadece aynı seviyedeki iş kolları arasında sıralama yapılabilir'). No console errors related to this feature (only unrelated /api/weather 502).

issues: Kargolama root category is not rendered in the tree because it has 0 tasks in the current 'Benim Görevlerim' scope (visibility filter is scope-based). Expected per test data note but is by design — orderedCategories only includes visible-in-scope categories. Not a regression from this feature, but worth confirming with product intent.

action_items: API CLEANUP REQUIRED (testing agent could not run via in-browser fetch — cookies are httpOnly so /api call returned 401 without Bearer token). Main agent to run via curl with admin token: (1) PATCH /api/tasks/c7a20d73-372e-4e0b-8064-e8db969c1d9e body {"category_id": "dad15459-f463-40ec-876c-817577e5d811"}; (2) PATCH /api/tasks/eb0c0b7f-8522-4bf0-80af-53f421a75dda same; (3) DELETE /api/task-categories/c79ebe99-ec7a-41ac-877f-58c8c41ea7ba (QA_AltA); (4) DELETE /api/task-categories/6f386bae-bdbc-4d82-ba46-fb6a91e7972e (QA_AltB).
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is 2419 lines — file continues to grow well beyond the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting the filter-tree (renderFilterNode + catForest + toggleFilterNode) into its own component/file for maintainability.
catFilterPrefs.js is clean and well-scoped; good separation. Uses try/catch on both read and write. LGTM.
renderFilterNode correctly guards non-drag on Fason Verme drag onto a different-parent target via handleCatDrop parent_id equality — sibling-only enforced.
Minor: HTML5 drag reorder was not automated (Playwright drag with custom DnD is unreliable). Code path (parent_id check + toast.info) was inspected manually.

rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as spec. Only ‘issue’ noted is that Kargolama is not rendered (0 tasks in scope), which is the pre-existing scope-based visibility behavior of orderedCategories, not a regression from this feature.
